lines: This 30-second ad started as 7 rough drafts. Now you can watch both at once.
It's called Null Motion: the finished ad on top, its drafts underneath, in sync, frame for frame.
Ads look effortless, but every one starts as a plan: which idea goes where, when each move lands.
It finds every real scene change, then cuts the ad into 3–8 sections.
Each section gets one plain draft: black and white, one simple move.
The film's clock drives every draft, and the one on screen is outlined in orange.
Then one click exports it all, frame by frame, without dropping one.
Three example ads ship with the repo, already split into 7, 8 and 3 drafts.
No npm install, no API keys, no account. It works on the first run.
Clone it, run npm start, and hit Download in Chrome or Edge.
Your own ads stay local, and the page never calls an outside server.
Null Motion. Free, local, and 705 stars on GitHub.
